official_status: RETAINED -- promoted to the current complete root
decision: PROMOTED. The pre-registered promotion rule (plan section 2: 'an equal official score with a faster official time and under 300s promotes'; AGENTS section 2: the v202 precedent, 'an equal-score speed-up may be promoted when the official time is faster and under 300s, but only when its score is not below the current root') is satisfied on both counts: the score is the parent's 18518, not lower, and 289s is under the 300s limit and 2s faster than the parent's 291s. The root moves from v231 (18518/291s) to v237 (18518/289s); the fallback root stays v233 (18428/288s).
local_prediction_was_negative_and_is_ref: The three-arm paired timing was a null reading on every row (|effect|/|null| of 0.52/0.52/1.11/1.00x, sign flipping between rows, 10-17 of 31 rounds). The archive stated no claim that the effect would be resolvable officially, and a submission recommendation issued in this repository went further and argued the card was probably not worth a submission slot. That recommendation is refuted by this return. Plan section 2 step 6 states the governing rule -- 'a locally unresolvable difference does not veto the official cost verification' -- and v233 (L-TF1) had already demonstrated it by measuring -4s officially while every local clock was unable to resolve the change. The correction is recorded here rather than dropped: local time readings must not be used to veto submissions of pure time candidates.
family_reading: v233 measured -4s on the K=1 parent (v230, 292s) and v237 measures -2s on the K=2 parent (v231, 291s). Both are the same mechanism (reusing the first pass's gradient) on two different trees. The two readings are NOT additive and do not establish that the port lost 2s: the parents differ and each was measured once.
lineage_note: v237 is a descendant of the v231 root; it is not a descendant of v233. v238 (A-CT1) and v239 (A-CT2) were built on the old parent v231 and keep that parent; they are one root behind and are not additive with v237.
margin_change: The root's margin against the 300s limit moves from 9s to 11s. This is recorded as a fact; no candidate's official seconds are predicted from it, and 11s is not used as a new threshold.
